noAnswerOnlySolution.minimumStandard: Every production question contains a student-reproducible solution, not only a bare answer.

conceptExplained.minimumStandard: Solutions state the governing concept before applying it to the source conditions.

conditionsInterpreted.minimumStandard: Solutions restate the operative domain, hypotheses, or case conditions before calculation.

intermediateReasoningPreserved.minimumStandard: Solutions retain the decisive intermediate equations or logical implications.

choiceConclusionNumber.minimumStandard: Objective solutions explicitly conclude with the option number after deriving the result.

highLevelNoLogicJump.minimumStandard: High-level questions include the nontrivial bridge and do not jump from setup to answer.

subjectiveStepsSufficient.minimumStandard: Constructed-response solutions contain enough ordered steps to reproduce the requested proof or calculation.

problemSolutionImagesSeparate.minimumStandard: Problem image assets and instructional solution images are distinct fields and paths.

beneficialVisualsUsed.minimumStandard: When a graph materially clarifies the explanation, a solution visual is attached and used.

visualAltCaption.minimumStandard: Attached solution visuals carry descriptive alt text and a caption.

visualMathParity.minimumStandard: Graph/diagram solution visuals preserve the mathematical facts used by the solution.
